terms.remedy: Mistral AI reserves the right to terminate the Agreement or just the affected Mistral AI Products undergoing the Subprocessor change
terms.quote: The Customer may only object in writing to Mistral AI’s appointment of a new Subprocessor within ten (10) days of such notice by providing a written objection to privacy@mistral.ai, provided that such objection is based on reasonable grounds relating to the Applicable Data Protection Law, otherwise such new Subprocessor will be deemed approved.
